name: Naturalisation by Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires legal residence of at least 7 years, per the Immigration Department's stated citizenship-eligibility threshold for Resident Permit holders.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of legal residence in Antigua and Barbuda.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be an adult of full legal capacity.
Applicant must be of good character, with no disqualifying criminal history, bankruptcy, or evidence of insufficient financial means to be self-supporting.

sources.title: Immigration Department, Antigua and Barbuda -- Residency Permit FAQs: 'apply for Antiguan Citizenship after seven years of residing legally' in the country

Wikipedia -- Antiguan and Barbudan nationality law: Citizenship Act naturalisation formula (12 months immediately preceding application, plus 5 of the prior 7 years), adult/good-character/self-sufficiency assessment, Oath of Allegiance, dual citizenship expressly permitted since the 1981 Constitution

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Antigua and Barbuda's initial build. The hard residence-duration requirement is sourced to the tier-1 Immigration Department FAQ's own 7-year figure, kept published on that basis; the more granular 12-months-immediately-preceding-plus-5-of-prior-7-years breakdown, the adult/good-character assessment, and the Oath of Allegiance are corroborating detail from a tier-4 secondary source and have NOT been independently verified against the Citizenship Act 1982 text directly (not retrieved in this pass) -- treated as reasonably reliable corroboration of a tier-1-confirmed route rather than the sole basis for a hard requirement, since the core duration figure already has tier-1 backing. See ag_resident_permit_general.json's notes for the flagged 6-vs-7-year discrepancy between these two ways of describing the same residence threshold. prerequisites references both Resident Permit routes since naturalisation by residence is the natural endpoint of either the general/independent-means/entrepreneur Resident Permit or the marriage-based one (for a spouse who does not first hit the faster 3-year ag_citizenship_by_marriage.json ground).
